name: Cold Comforts
source:
With the government currently experiencing a population crisis,
you’ve been recently hired as the lead preliminary mortician for S-City’s morgue,
as mortuary-related work has become high in demand.
You’ll need to record details and get up close and personal with the dead, but how close? Well, that’s up to you!
